ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this trip (TRP-02820) is decided on the GPS trace and the trip record, both clean and at full weight (1.0), so the confidence cap is 1.0 and no escalation trigger fires.

The distance. The trace records 4.04 km driven (EV-GPS-02820), against a booked optimal route of 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02820). The excess is 0.84 km, which is 26.25% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests therefore pass (more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace. The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 46 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 seconds, so no independent corroboration is needed. The excess is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 50% and under 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 uplift is not available.

The driver's explanation. The statement on file, 'One-way streets', is a general traffic assertion and is rejected. There is no traffic advisory covering this trip: EV-ADVIS-02820-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the deviation stands at the measured figure. The driver cited no advisory identifier, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction and the case does not escalate. Two claims making this point failed the referee's impairment-disclosure check and are recorded below.

The refund. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02820), and the surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier. POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 8.68. Charged_total = 9.70. Refund = 9.70 - 8.68 = 1.02, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 1.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND.

Other checks. The chat log carries 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04) and no point relocation (POL-RD-05); the vehicle is RYDE_X, not a pooled trip (POL-RD-12). No ERP gantries, tolls or surcharges appear, so no POL-RD-09 correction and no billing-integrity referral. The billed distance (4.0 km) is not more than 1.0 km below the trace, so no driver compensation is due. The driver profile shows 0 deviation flags in 90 days against 408 completed trips, so no POL-RD-06 conduct referral. The rider profile (1 deviation claim in 60 days) does not require extra corroboration. The trip identifiers and timestamps match across the trip record, trace and fare breakdown, and no escalation trigger under POL-RD-10 fires.

The monetary effect (SGD 1.05) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund is executed automatically on issue. Both parties may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
